email.body1:
Jessica, saw Foursquare is folding Placed in from Snap and making it the flagship measurement product.

A move that big usually means more in-market advertisers and agencies than the team can enable and cover at once, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Foursquare off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jessica, quick follow-up for Foursquare.

After a flagship launch, the pipeline target tends to jump faster than reps can ramp, and most enablement teams cannot say exactly how many meetings the team needs to hit it. The gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Foursquare needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jessica, last bit of proof for Foursquare.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Foursquare's reply rate likely compares to peer measurement and ad-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your measurement motion? I will tailor it to Foursquare either way.
